title: SafeStep Participant Payment Terms for Amounts Above the Allowance
content:
# Participant Payment Terms

These terms state, for each tier of the SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program, how a participant pays for the part of a purchase that is above the allowance, and the discount off retail applied to that employee-paid amount.

| Tier | Discount off retail on the employee-paid amount | Payment methods for the employee-paid amount | Payroll deduction available | Largest employee-paid amount per purchase taken by payroll deduction (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 10 percent | Card | No | 0.00 |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 10 percent | Card; payroll deduction | Yes | 75.00 |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 15 percent | Card; payroll deduction | Yes | 100.00 |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 15 percent | Card; payroll deduction | Yes | 125.00 |
| SafeStep Premier | 20 percent | Card; payroll deduction | Yes | 150.00 |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 20 percent | Card; payroll deduction | Yes | 200.00 |

## Terms explained

1. **Discount.** The percentage in the second column is a discount off retail on the amount the employee pays above the allowance.
2. **Card.** Card is a payment method for the employee-paid amount on every tier.
3. **Payroll deduction.** Payroll deduction is a payment method on every tier except SafeStep Voucher Basic, where it is not available and its per-purchase limit is 0.00.
4. **Per-purchase limit.** The last column is the largest employee-paid amount that payroll deduction takes on any one purchase; the limit applies per purchase.

## Questions on these terms

**May a participant on SafeStep Voucher Basic have the amount above the allowance taken from pay?**
No. On that tier payroll deduction is not available; the payment method is card.

**What is the most payroll deduction takes on one purchase on SafeStep Premier?**
150.00 US dollars per purchase.

**Which tiers give a 20 percent discount on the employee-paid amount?**
SafeStep Premier and SafeStep Enterprise.
